question: Where’s the closest hotel in the west direction from Amazing Air, San Antonio, TX?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Amazing Air%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Antonio%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 ), p.geometry )) BETWEEN 247.5 AND 292.5 ORDER BY ST_Distance( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Amazing Air%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Antonio%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%TX%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, p.geometry::geography ) LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: Homewood Suites by Hilton San Antonio Airport
